notes.title: Project SWARM | TEASER 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Project SWARM: Drone Space Exploration Simulator
TEASER 2024 is released.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43532482/e2b7c6126d776c7f52401506e04ff4aa70562960.jpg[/img]


[b]Prepare to become one of the FIRST Elite Operator in this unique and simulation experience![/b]

2024 is the year when we begin full-scale space exploration!
[b]2024 is the year of SWARM - Drone Space Exploration Simulator.[/b]

[i][b]Is SWARM a game?
It`s best to refer to it as a Simulator. [/b][/i]
We can`t share details for now, they are classified but first drones are already working.

We will invite small group from SWARM`s community for closed testing.

[b]So Follow and Wishlist as soon as You are ready![/b]

See You in Space!

notes.title: Project SWARM: Drone Space Exploration Program is part of a NEXT FEST 202
notes.notes:
[b]Project SWARM: Drone Space Exploration Program[/b] is part of a NEXT FEST 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43532482/820b4ee6e25f0ef85f4dddfda2634bf207ae7ade.jpg[/img]

[b][i]"Reach where the sight does not reach"[/i]
Adam Mickiewicz, "Ode to Youth"[/b]

SWARM is part of the Next Fest Summer 2023 on Steam!
Instead of demo we will release the full version in Early Access.
Project is big Your participation as an Operator is very important!
[b]Join our Journey today![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43532482/dc6f1e95f8ac8cfd5e174af2add8fa035808ead4.jpg[/img]

[b]Program will be open for Operators Worldwide, with certain limitations.
Sign up early to reserve Your spot in the First Launch![/b]

Register by Following Project Swarm and Wishlisting. If You wish to operate Your SWARM with a Friend or a Family Member, let them know it`s time to sign up.
You will be informed about Updates and Pale Blue OS for Operators.
